required_evidence: Authenticated package bytes; branch head; reviewer assignment record; procedure list
completion_criterion: Every planned procedure has an evidence locator or a recorded exclusion
prohibited_conclusion: Do not conclude audit certification, independent assurance, compliance, readiness for production, or Founder approval

required_evidence: Document inventory; exclusion rationale; unresolved issue link
completion_criterion: Each exclusion has a basis and residual-risk treatment
prohibited_conclusion: Do not imply excluded matters are resolved

required_evidence: Source file bytes; checksum records; repository locator
completion_criterion: All listed sources have hash and byte length
prohibited_conclusion: Do not imply source approval, adoption, or canonical status

required_evidence: Referenced records; validation output; review notes
completion_criterion: Every evidence row resolves to a package file or external authenticated input
prohibited_conclusion: Do not imply evidence has been accepted by Founder

required_evidence: Population register; sampled rows; selection record
completion_criterion: Sample basis is reproducible and limitations are explicit
prohibited_conclusion: Do not imply sampled review proves unsampled rows

required_evidence: Disclosure statement; review assignment; conflict cross-reference
completion_criterion: All limitations are recorded and unresolved limitations remain open
prohibited_conclusion: Do not claim independence when review is Founder-directed or machine-assisted

required_evidence: Conflict source; mitigation evidence; residual risk link
completion_criterion: Each conflict has mitigation or explicit unresolved status
prohibited_conclusion: Do not imply acceptance of conflict or risk

required_evidence: Finding register row; source review; validation evidence
completion_criterion: Every finding has status, evidence, residual risk, and closure authority
prohibited_conclusion: Do not imply Founder acceptance, waiver, or closure authority

required_evidence: Risk source; mitigation record; decision dependency
completion_criterion: Each risk has individual treatment and Founder-action flag
prohibited_conclusion: Do not imply bulk acceptance or indefinite waiver

required_evidence: Founder instruction if later supplied; evidence locator
completion_criterion: Every row remains unanswered absent authenticated instruction
prohibited_conclusion: Do not imply decision, appointment, certification, or production approval

required_evidence: Authenticated Founder instruction if supplied later
prohibited_conclusion: Do not imply ratification or approval from review preparation

required_evidence: Authenticated adoption instruction; manifest hash; unresolved risks
completion_criterion: Record remains NOT_ADOPTED unless authenticated evidence exists
prohibited_conclusion: Do not imply adoption from draft PR or validation success

required_evidence: Commit SHA; file list; checksum; PR link
completion_criterion: Receipt identifies exact commit and package bytes
prohibited_conclusion: Do not imply protected-branch merge unless merge receipt exists

required_evidence: GitHub merge metadata; branch protection observation
completion_criterion: All merge parents and protected head reconcile
prohibited_conclusion: Do not create a merge record for draft PRs

required_evidence: Final manifest; validation report; unresolved register
completion_criterion: All blockers closed or incomplete determination is issued
prohibited_conclusion: Do not imply certification complete or unresolved issues closed

required_evidence: Validation report; negative-control evidence; limitation log
completion_criterion: All checks identify capability and limitations
prohibited_conclusion: Do not imply certification or external accreditation

required_evidence: Regression evidence; changed hash; review finding
completion_criterion: Trigger and affected records are specific
prohibited_conclusion: Do not imply remediation has occurred

required_evidence: Review calendar; role assignment evidence; package hash
completion_criterion: Next review condition is operable or explicitly blocked
prohibited_conclusion: Do not imply active governance unless roles are appointed
